title: Their line steps up: stay onside
titleKid: Their defenders come forward: stay onside
brief: Your #8 is closed down and plays the ball back to your #6.
briefKid: Your midfielder is being chased and passes the ball back.
question: Their back line is stepping up. Where do you go?
questionKid: Their defenders are coming forward. Where do you go?

takeaway.standard: Stay on the last defender's shoulder as their line moves: when they step up, you come back with them so you stay onside and keep pinning them.
takeaway.kid: Their defenders come forward? Move back with them, so you stay onside.

misconceptions.text: You stayed high while their line stepped up, so you are now offside and the #6 cannot play you in.
misconceptions.textKid: You stayed up there and now you are offside. Step back with their defenders.

misconceptions.text: You dropped all the way back toward the ball, so nobody is pinning their back line and they can squeeze up on your midfield.
misconceptions.textKid: You came too far back. Stay level with their last defender.
